trace.scope: Instrumented diagnostic only. Stage wall/CPU totals sum across threads and overlap when nested. CPU excludes blocking/descheduling but not clock overhead. CPU clocks cover session/block/worker/voice and late stages. room-trace disables inner arithmetic-stage clocks entirely; room-profile alone retains inner stage wall times. Instrumented diagnostic only. Stage wall/CPU totals sum across threads and overlap when nested. CPU excludes blocking/descheduling but not clock overhead. CPU clocks cover session/block/worker/voice and late stages. room-trace disables inner arithmetic-stage clocks entirely; room-profile alone retains inner stage wall times. Waiting for other workers is not evidence of OS preemption. Capacity requires a separate unprofiled run.

diagnostic.scope: Separate V2 instrumented Release plus ETW, 512 distance-motion calls per configuration. CUDA event intervals can contain scheduling gaps. Worker-summed walls include parallel/nested scopes and cannot be added into call latency. Windows thread CPU clocks were quantized at 15.625 ms. No per-call ETW scheduling attribution was established.

macos_arm64_v1: eight-phase sparse-FIR time-domain oracle with full support, reset and fork
three GPU reference Session tests at 48/96 kHz
macos_arm64_v2: three reduced-reference GPU Session tests including LFE, headLocked, reset, switch and tail
nine quality and one zero-allocation test with GPU feature
nine quality and one zero-allocation test without GPU feature
windows: verified eight Audio workers in every selected run
default and world-only same-host complete numerical replay for both combinations

notes: Every experiment uses a fresh process per run. Source scheduling and resource identities are fixed. No deadline miss was excluded.
Normal desktop applications were retained; AC power and background snapshots are recorded. No task build or other benchmark overlapped timed acceptance.
The three-part configuration failed in its first distance long round; its remaining four rounds stopped. Its data were not pooled with the accepted two-part configuration.
Four-voice grouping remains a research switch for reproducing the screen, but is disabled in the accepted configuration and no overall gain was established.
Long-stage plain samples have 1024 calls, while candidate long rounds have 22500; their p99 and maxima must not be pooled or compared as equal-duration runs.
The accepted numerical replays each contain 231581 frames including the complete tail; no time alignment, gain fit or output cropping was used.
The isolated benchmark registers only the eight DSP workers. Production monitoring and Scene producer threads also have an outer Audio registration; real device playback remains unvalidated.
GPU reduction reduced nominal readback from 128 KiB to 4 KiB per 256-frame block at 32 sources, but the three-part long-test failure does not establish that this change caused its spike.
Frequent room switching remains observational. Earlier switching measurements are unchanged and were not rerun here.
Default exact/realtime and public C ABI do not select these experimental paths. Native GPU evidence is limited to the tested Windows CUDA/96 kHz resource family and at most 32 sources.
Published GPU trace text uses LF line endings; numeric records are unchanged. Original Windows logs remain in private evidence.
